rationale: M12.PHP-GROUPED-USE. `use C\{D, E as F};` produced NO import and NO `imports` edge, because the analyzer only looked for a `namespace_use_clause` among a declaration's DIRECT children while the grouped form nests them inside a `namespace_use_group` (with the prefix in a sibling `namespace_name`). Grouped use is the idiomatic modern form and it occurs ZERO times in both php corpora, which is why a full-corpus differential run over 4,139 files reported 100% coverage while missing it: the corpora cannot detect a construct they do not contain, and derivePhpEdges had the same blind spot, so both sides agreed on an absence. This fixture is the construct matrix doing the work a corpus cannot. Members are pinned QUALIFIED (App\Models\Post, not a bare Post) because that is the FQN PHP binds, and a bare leaf would collide across groups. The plain `use App\Models\User;` form is pinned too, so the fix cannot regress the case that already worked.

forbidRelationships.note: a grouped member must be QUALIFIED by the group prefix; a bare leaf would collide with every other group in a real codebase
the `as A` alias belongs on ImportInfo.items, not on the relationship target; the target is the bound FQN
